output.text: The farmers market committee gathered early on Saturday to set up the stalls before the crowds arrived. Assume that Jun is the treasurer. Kira arrived carrying baskets of fresh basil and mint, setting them on the table nearest the entrance. Dara helped her arrange the herbs so the labels faced outward toward the walking path. Ben booked the hall. Quinn is older than Kira. The morning air was cool, and vendors chatted while stringing up bunting between the wooden posts. Jun walked along the rows checking that every stall had a price sign, nodding when things looked orderly. Kira is older than Dara. A light breeze kept knocking over a stack of paper bags near the honey stand, and Ben laughed while chasing them down the aisle. Quinn is older than Dara. Dara set out jars of pickled vegetables beside a bowl of apples, arranging the colors so they looked appealing from a distance. Quinn measured six feet tall, a bit taller than most of the others helping that day, and stood near the entrance greeting visitors. Kira ranked among the first vendors to open, while Jun preferred to wander and check on everyone once the market had settled. Ben tends to arrive later than the rest, usually just as the crowd starts thickening near midday. By noon the market was full of chatter, the smell of baked bread mixing with fresh coffee, and everyone seemed pleased with how smoothly the day was going. Quinn eventually took a break near the fountain, watching people move from stall to stall with baskets full of vegetables and flowers.
